|lore=Of all the scum and villainy Lando had dealt with (pirates, smugglers, con-artists, thieves, swindlers, politicians and Imperial lackeys), he hated bounty hunters the most.
|game_text=USED: Take Houjix, Ounee Ta, or Scanner Techs into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain initiated by a lone Slave I. LOST: If an Imperial and a bounty hunter are in a battle together, draw one destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power.
